parameters.content:
## Every morning, find the ones who went quiet
A lead that nobody followed up is the most expensive thing a sales
team owns — it cost money to acquire and returns nothing. This runs
daily and works out who is due a nudge, using two queries rather
than one per person, so it stays well inside the CRM's rate limit.

nodes.name: 1. Every morning, find the ones who went quiet

parameters.content:
## Decide who is due, and stop when you should
Day 3, day 7, day 14 — then never again. It stops early if they
replied, if they opted out, or if they already became a real
opportunity. A sequence that does not know how to stop is how
companies end up in spam folders.

nodes.name: 2. Decide who is due, and stop when you should

parameters.content:
## Send it the only way anything can be sent
Each nudge goes through the send sub-workflow, so the consent gate
applies exactly as it does everywhere else. Someone who opted out
yesterday is refused here today, without this workflow needing to
know the rule.

nodes.name: 3. Send it the only way anything can be sent

meta.description: Follows up leads that went quiet, on day 3, 7 and 14, then stops. Exits the moment they reply, opt out, or become an opportunity.
